summary: Tested ergonomic post-sale confirmation panel in HPP Kalkulator > Jual dialog. All 5 test cases from review request passed: (1) Panel jual-sukses shown while dialog stays open with Nota no, Pemasukan +total, Saldo Kas Sekarang, Sisa Stok. (2) Saldo panel = saldoSebelum + total (13.857.858 + 200.000 = 14.057.858, verified). (3) Jual Lagi resets qty to 1 and reopens form. (4) Unduh Nota + Selesai buttons present and functional. (5) Regression: stok decreased 10->7 after selling qty 2+1; card-saldo-kas on dashboard increased by exactly Rp300.000 after closing dialog. Cleanup executed (2 test sales deleted, product harga_jual/stok reset to 0).
critical_code_review_comments: confirmJual computes sisaStok from jualRow.stok captured at dialog open; if user rapid-fires 'Jual Lagi' before refresh() completes, jualLagi() reads latest from rows via find, which is correct. OK.

cashBalance prop is used to compute panel saldo before backend refresh. This is fine for a single sale but if parent cashBalance is stale (parent re-renders after onSold), race could theoretically show slightly stale value—empirically it worked (14.057.858 & 14.157.858 both correct).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set harga_jual=100000, stok=10 on first Branding product (Kaos Polos) and created 2 test sales; cleaned up afterwards (sales deleted, product reset to harga_jual=0, stok=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified end-to-end via UI on live preview URL. testids used: tab-hpp, hpp-tab-Branding, hpp-row-<id>, hpp-harga-<id>, hpp-stok-<id>, hpp-jual-<id>, jual-dialog, jual-qty-input, jual-catat-btn, jual-sukses, jual-sukses-saldo, jual-lagi-btn, jual-sukses-nota-btn, jual-tutup-btn, card-saldo-kas.
